statement.text: This problem is concerned with the stable 4-genus $g_{s}(K)$ of a knot $K$, defined below. (a) Is there a knot $K$ such that $g_{s}(K) \in \mathbb{Q}\setminus\mathbb{Z}$? (b) Is there a knot $K$ such that $g_{s}(K) \notin \mathbb{Q}$? (c) Is there a knot $K$ such that $0 < g_{s}(K) < 1/2$? (d) [Liv10, Question 1] Does $K$ represent a torsion element in the concor- dance group if and only if $g_{s}(K) = 0$?

title: Kirby Problem 1.41
